learningPoints.en: The native web bridge forwards chunks directly for responses not requiring rewriting, avoiding whole-stream buffering of SSE. A shared taking Promise coalesces hosted takeover when the CLI service disappears, and the inject Promise is returned so the host can await assembly.

learningPoints.zh: task_worker 先做提示词估算预算拒绝，再按调用会话信号量拒绝超并发，不自动切换模型。settleRun 等结果后始终 dispose，并保留执行和释放双重异常；非 completed 的 stopReason 返回失败，超长结果截断同时保存全文 artifact，finally 释放并发槽。

learningPoints.zh: 宿主 apply 先按 win32 门控，再以固定 argv 启动包内 tray.ps1；DataDir 指向 DSH_HOME/dsh-tray 而非版本化 npm 目录，dispose 调用 child.kill。可学习平台隔离与可更新数据目录的分离，但仅 kill 直接子进程不能据此证明整棵进程树已结算。

reason.en: Declare analysis versus implementation intent first, then freeze evidence using source line ranges and hashes rather than self-reported completion.

reason.zh: 将技能阶段和delegate_skill绑定，使不同开发技能可选不同子代理模型；应按任务激活而非全局强塞流程。
reason.en: Bind skill stages to delegate_skill so different development skills can choose different worker models; activate per task instead of globally imposing the workflow.

reason.zh: 纠正reviews.json中四主面尚待角色映射的暂缓，而非推翻内部角色排除：清单注册四个preset，补丁的agent字段进入Runtime.agentId，再进入loadAgentPrompt、systemPrompt及实际角色权限/技能注册。Sisyphus为全域统筹，Hephaestus为受限派工的深度实现，Prometheus写域限.omd/并交接批准计划，Atlas不直接write/edit而指挥批准计划。四者是主会话入口；名字相似的slim只有一个原生预设，hawk只有命令/技能，无同构重复。
reason.en: Resolves only the four-primary role-mapping hold in reviews.json, not the internal-role exclusions: declared preset agent fields flow through Runtime.agentId, loadAgentPrompt, systemPrompt and real permission/skill registration. reason.zh: 把个人代理的对外信息压成可用/勉强/需本人点头三态，保留原始隐私本地并把例外决定交还本人。

reason.zh: 跨工作区worker由幂等名称绑定，报告必须包含答案本身；reviewer区分观察与推断，auditor把每个数字和done声明重新对照原始证据。
reason.en: Bind cross-workspace workers by idempotent names and require reports to contain the answer itself; reviewers separate observation from inference, while auditors recheck numbers and done claims against primary evidence.

reason.en: Distinguish committed progress from unclaimed tasks, using a dedicated xingyuan service and preset entry so the assistant does not make commitment decisions for the user.

reason.zh: PM强制边界表、reviewer列规格沉默清单、QA每类边界至少一项负断言；这些是不同交付责任，不能把lint/build成功当运行正确。
reason.en: PM requires a boundary table, reviewers enumerate specification silence, and QA adds negative assertions per boundary family; these distinct duties prevent treating lint/build success as runtime correctness.

reason.zh: 把演示文稿生成收敛为单独模式，保留既有权限而不重复请求提权；生成后做逐页渲染复核，不修改标准模式。
reason.en: Isolate presentation generation in its own mode, respect existing permissions without redundant escalation, and render/review slides without modifying standard mode.

reason.zh: 探索结果与独立评估分开，拒绝最终交付也可保留有独立证据支持的局部结论；宿主fiber失活要显式退回空态。
reason.en: Separate exploration from independent evaluation so rejected delivery can retain supported local claims; explicitly fall back to an empty state when the host fiber deactivates.

reason.zh: 伙伴人格、执行者和只读检索员分别有不同工具面；核心记忆常驻、分类档案按需读取，摘录员必须保留数字/页码而不替派发者下结论。
reason.en: Companion, executor, and read-only retriever have distinct tool surfaces; keep core memory resident and load archives on demand, requiring exact numbers/pages in extracts without delegating conclusions to the retriever.

reason.en: Use atn_start to establish a shared objective and network/node/task identities, keeping collaboration within independent budgets; enterprise security claims still require separate verification.

reason.zh: 日常编码面主动移除目标、计划、子代理和TODO，减少编排开销；同时保留不可逆发布操作必须核对远端事实的边界。
reason.en: Remove goals, planning, workers and TODO from routine coding to reduce orchestration overhead, while retaining read-only remote verification for irreversible publishing operations.

reason.zh: 按工具结果、PTC派发和压缩事件安排上下文整理，scheduled集合防同会话重复调度；信息保留应围绕后续执行所需而不只看固定阈值。
reason.en: Schedule context organization from tool/PTC/compaction events with per-session deduplication; retain information based on future execution needs rather than a fixed threshold alone.

reason.zh: 防守指挥台把事实库、任务队列和授权范围分开约束；外部日志/样本作为不可信数据，改配置前记录回滚值。七个明确不要手选的worker不计独立用户预设。
reason.en: Separate the defensive fact store, queue and authorized scope; treat logs/samples as untrusted data and record rollback values before configuration changes. Seven explicitly non-manual workers are not counted as user presets.

reason.zh: 窄调度器只交自包含任务给不可恢复的外部子代理，区分返回任务id与真正完成通知，等待期间不得重复派单。
reason.en: A narrow dispatcher sends self-contained tasks to non-resumable external workers, distinguishing job IDs from completion notices and preventing duplicate dispatch while waiting.

reason.zh: 清理先只读发现、分风险等级、出manifest，再按明确确认删除；优先回收站，不能把检查或模糊同意当删除授权。
reason.en: Discover read-only, tier risks, and present a manifest before explicitly approved deletion; prefer trash and never treat checks or vague assent as deletion authorization.

reason.zh: 把只读规划与写入实施分别交给不同provider；只分析请求不强派执行，用户明确不要规划时允许直接实施通道。
reason.en: Assign read-only planning and implementation to different providers; do not force execution for analysis-only requests, and allow an explicit user request to skip planning.

reason.zh: 专用provider及作用域同名遮蔽限制唯一执行工具，任务书提前补足范围/禁改项/验收，避免子代理不能追问时靠猜。
reason.en: Use a dedicated provider and scoped shadowing to constrain the execution surface, supplying scope, prohibitions and acceptance up front when workers cannot ask follow-ups.

reason.zh: 把专属绘图工具严格留在drawing预设，先状态自检与查规范tag再让用户确认提示词，不给通用模式平添工具噪声。
reason.en: Keep drawing tools inside the drawing preset, checking environment and canonical tags before confirming prompts, instead of adding tool noise to general modes.

reason.zh: 纯声明式组合降低升级面；文档描述当前事实，不把未经确认的实现偏差写成业务规则，提交推送仍需明确指示。
reason.en: A configuration-only composition narrows upgrade exposure; document current facts without turning unapproved implementation drift into business policy, keeping commits/pushes explicitly authorized.

reason.zh: 真实manifest补丁插入Host桥和独立preset-draw/id draw；Host index.js注册五个draw_*工具，配置子树完整可追踪。和已计drawing不是同构fork：drawing把19个comfyui_*工具限定在预设、内置Anima/Krea2与角色tag/LoRA规则；draw是宿主全局五工具的空工作流框架，按用户API JSON/sidecar识别slots、不带模型管线，且persona、规划/工具树不同。
reason.en: The actual manifest patch inserts the host bridge and a separate preset-draw/id draw; index.js registers five draw_* tools and the complete preset subtree is traceable. It is not isomorphic to accepted drawing: drawing scopes nineteen comfyui_* tools and supplies Anima/Krea2/tag/LoRA policies; draw is a host-wide five-tool empty workflow framework with user API JSON/sidecar slot discovery, no model pipeline, and a different persona/planning/tool tree.

reason.zh: 将目标/基本点/硬软需求与任务树挂钩，按任务类别读画像而非灌入全部；UI对齐栏样式与正文分离。
reason.en: Bind goals, principles and hard/soft requirements to a task tree, load profiles by task category, and style alignment metadata separately from answer content.

reason.zh: 按大型实施、小型实施、只读分诊，避免每次继续或追问都重开完整流程；用户纠正立即作废旧任务书，门禁按风险分级。
reason.en: Triage large implementation, small implementation and read-only work instead of restarting the whole workflow on follow-ups; invalidate briefs on user correction and grade gates by risk.

reason.zh: 人格投影为原生会话prompt，记忆/平台作为可选独立子插件；配置面板不是另一套聊天运行时。
reason.en: Project the persona into native session prompts while keeping memory/platform adapters optional; a configuration panel need not become another chat runtime.

reason.zh: 按工作阶段而非48个岗位压缩为情景模式：概念砍范围、GDD写边界/参数/验收、实现留测证、QA列未覆盖、发布列可执行回滚；十个用户面是真正不同的交付契约，仍只有一个项目。
reason.en: Organize scenarios by production stage rather than 48 job titles: constrain concepts, define GDD boundaries/parameters/acceptance, retain implementation tests, report QA gaps, and require executable release rollback. Ten user-facing contracts remain one project.

reason.zh: 开场检查真正Team工具，不拿普通subagent冒充teammate；写作用域分离，任务板revision认领与消息唤醒分清职责。

reason.en: Verify vendor commands against bundled references, cite them and lower confidence for medium-verified material; register skills with resourceBase for real resource resolution.

reason.zh: manifest真实补丁在宿主>=0.1.7时声明preset-novel-solo/id novel-solo，README区分当前声明和旧目录部署，旧路径不另计。动态persona从实际template/persona.md读取，生成补丁与template/agent.cordis.yml仅在本地插件路径转包导出子路径处不同；导出插件真实监听agent/request并对llama设toolChoice:auto。保留str_replace_editor、文件、pwsh及内部spawn/fork审核，禁用web/goal/workflow等；与story的聊天走向开关和tavernweave角色卡/检索不是换名或同构。只计用户写作主面，不计审核子代理或N的不同值。
reason.en: The actual manifest patch declares preset-novel-solo/id novel-solo on hosts >=0.1.7; README distinguishes current declaration from legacy directory deployment, which adds no extra count. The dynamic persona reads real template/persona.md; generated rows match template/agent.cordis.yml except the local plugin path being replaced by its exported subpath. That exported plugin really hooks agent/request and pins llama toolChoice:auto. Its str_replace_editor/files/pwsh/internal spawn/fork-review surface disables web/goals/workflow; it is not a rename/isomorph of story's chat-branch toggle or TavernWeave's cards/retrieval. Count only the user writing face, not review children or different N values.

reason.en: Reuse paired persistent sessions instead of respawning workers per task, recording task-start/report protocol and exposing plans in the composer dock.

Its exported run-state row calls the host pentester service to register domain tools and install root allowlisting/state injection. Persistent PentestRun lifecycle, PTES stage advance/rollback and coverage gates distinguish it from broad blue/red-team dispatch. Count only one root.

reason.en: Verify quotations word-for-word against the corpus, distinguish historical context from modern analogy, and conclude with a testable near-term action; never fabricate quotations.

reason.zh: 声明式四角色委派按阶段传完整任务包与verdict，且明确persona只是治理约定，不是假装自动FSM或权限隔离。
reason.en: Pass complete task packages and verdicts across declarative role stages, explicitly treating persona guidance as governance rather than an automatic FSM or permission boundary.

reason.zh: 持久teammate与一次性subagent工具面在agent创建时加调用guard，硬隔离比仅在persona里要求更可审计。
reason.en: Install invocation guards at agent creation to separate persistent teammate and one-shot subagent surfaces, making isolation more auditable than persona-only instructions.

reason.zh: manifest真实补丁插入Host工具插件和独立preset-presentations；README明确在新会话模式选择器出现。子树为演示设计persona、只读文件、网页、提问、TODO、present和隔离压缩；Host index.js实际注册11个pptx_*工具。区别于已计ppt-assistant的引擎脚本/完整文件执行面，本面以有状态元素id/模板/原生工具操作OOXML；不是翻译或换名。
reason.en: The manifest-declared patch inserts both the host tool plugin and a separate preset-presentations; README explicitly places it in the new-session mode picker. Its composition is a deck-design persona, read-only files, web, questions, TODO, present and isolated compaction; host index.js actually registers eleven pptx_* tools. Unlike accepted ppt-assistant's engine scripts/full file execution, it operates OOXML via stateful element ids, templates and native tools, not translation or renaming.

reason.zh: 按可观测任务规模决定是否规划/委派，独立工作并行、有依赖串行；来源承认这不是所有委派路径的强制隔离。
reason.en: Use observable task size to trigger planning/delegation, parallelize independent work and serialize dependencies; the source admits this does not enforce isolation across every route.

reason.zh: 事实标记文件/检索/记忆三类，记忆必须转成可查来源才能进结论；开工先写可运行完成条件，交叉模型验证按用户要求而非强制扇出。
reason.en: Label file/search/memory facts, upgrading memory to inspectable evidence before conclusions; define executable completion conditions and reserve model cross-checks for user-requested cases.

reason.zh: 可取的通用机制是每个假设带预期证据、失败信号和停止条件，并要求发现落库；内部六个明确不要手选的worker不凑独立配置数。
reason.en: Generalizable mechanisms attach expected evidence, failure signals and stop conditions to hypotheses and persist findings; six explicitly non-manual workers do not inflate independent configuration counts.

reason.zh: 把原先全局桥转成preset子树，工具注册继承scope，未选模式不挂载桥；只研究封装边界，不安装REA或执行其npx载荷。
reason.en: Move a global bridge into a preset subtree so tool registration inherits scope and unselected modes do not mount it; study encapsulation without installing REA or running its npx payload.

reason.zh: 根据运行时委派标记确定root/worker身份，决定留在root、执行在隔离worker；禁止任务结束留下进程，Cordis面另加只读运行时检查能力。
reason.en: Derive root/worker identity from runtime delegation markers, keep decisions at root and execution in fenced workers, prohibit surviving processes, and add read-only runtime inspection only in the Cordis face.

reason.zh: 根据运行时委派标记确定root/worker身份，决定留在root、执行在隔离worker；禁止任务结束留下进程，Cordis面另加只读运行时检查能力。
reason.en: Derive root/worker identity from runtime delegation markers, keep decisions at root and execution in fenced workers, prohibit surviving processes, and add read-only runtime inspection only in the Cordis face.

reason.zh: 把always-on技能缩为常驻persona，细则按需加载；turn-stopping检查是否有真实验证和重复失败，并先排除不适用子会话。
reason.en: Condense always-on guidance into a resident persona while loading details on demand; check real verification and repeated failures at turn-stopping, excluding inapplicable child sessions first.

reason.zh: 用户选择开关通过会话投影/命令持久化，再在请求中注入固定数量互斥走向；不要把UI瞬时状态当会话事实。
reason.en: Persist a choice toggle through session projections/commands, then inject a fixed set of mutually exclusive branches into requests; transient UI state is not session truth.

reason.zh: 回答区分知识库正文、模型未验证知识和必要联网；关联卡不是答案，枚举查询与相关性检索分开，避免倒出整库。
reason.en: Distinguish knowledge-base text, unverified model knowledge and necessary web checks; linked cards are not answers, and separate enumeration from relevance retrieval to avoid dumping the whole store.

reason.zh: 长记忆通过宿主domain表提供服务，压缩与shell是独立组合面；README基准只代表维护者给定版本/预算的报告，不外推到当前任务。
reason.en: Provide long-memory through host domain tables and separate compaction/shell composition surfaces; README benchmarks apply only to the maintainer's reported versions and budgets, not this task.

reason.zh: 规划面保留提问、读写计划和证据工具但不挂代理执行链；解释patch与include的baseUrl差异，动态读取提示词保持原文而非在研究中eval。
reason.en: Keep questions, plan artifacts and evidence tools without a worker execution chain; distinguish patch/include baseUrl behavior and preserve dynamic prompt reads without evaluating them during research.

reason.zh: 旅行模式先环境自检，必需key缺失停下、可选增强不阻断；密钥状态只返回脱敏前缀/长度，规划查询不代订代付。
reason.en: Check the environment first, block on missing required keys but not optional enhancements, expose only redacted key status, and separate planning/querying from booking/payment.

reason.zh: 真实单补丁有顶层semantic-core MCP、状态插件与独立preset-dlr/id dlr。交互会话显式选择该面，persona complete、关闭runtimeContext、禁默认技能根、仅paradigm技能与隔离压缩，不是通用编码面换名。lib/index.js把包内skills目录设入DLR_SKILLS_DIR并处理AGENTS副本；真实AGENTS/技能给出LE/PE/ARC与两跳映射契约。MCP是组合支持能力，不把泛MCP包本身当原生预设；只计DLR交互面一个。
reason.en: The actual single patch contains a top-level semantic-core MCP client, status plugin and a separate preset-dlr/id dlr. Interactive sessions explicitly select this complete persona with runtime-context suppression, disabled default skill roots, paradigm-only skills and isolated compaction: not a renamed coding face. lib/index.js binds the packaged skills directory to DLR_SKILLS_DIR and handles the AGENTS copy; real AGENTS/skill files specify LE/PE/ARC and two-hop mapping. The MCP client supports the native composition; a generic MCP package is not itself counted. Count one DLR interactive face.

reason.zh: 定位证据→改后回读→可复现命令三道门，把完整工具结果和更晚压缩用于保真，不把少token当唯一目标。
reason.en: Use locate-evidence→read-back→reproducible-command gates, preserving full tool outputs and delaying compaction rather than optimizing tokens alone.

reason.zh: 不同人格使用独立记忆文件，滚动摘要设条数上限并归档；prompt语言约定不等于宿主有隐藏的思考语言开关。
reason.en: Use independent memory files per persona and bounded archived rolling summaries; prompt language conventions do not imply a hidden host reasoning-language switch.

reason.zh: 不同人格使用独立记忆文件，滚动摘要设条数上限并归档；prompt语言约定不等于宿主有隐藏的思考语言开关。
reason.en: Use independent memory files per persona and bounded archived rolling summaries; prompt language conventions do not imply a hidden host reasoning-language switch.

reason.zh: 经典语料用篇序/职官坐标检索引用，工作责任、协作接口与考核指标分清；引用必须回到原文而非记忆背诵。
reason.en: Retrieve classical text through section/office coordinates while separating duties, interfaces and measurable review; quotations must return to the source rather than memory.

reason.zh: 真实补丁独立声明preset-fast/id fast；README明确可手选且默认模式仍是用户选择。不是重发四个官方builtin：实际移除规划、目标、调度链并重写直接行动/证据/验证契约。与awesome比较，fast保留pwsh、TODO、web、present及tool-result-pruner，awesome明确去TODO并改shell/fs/search/压缩阈值；两者工具结构和任务契约实质不同。
reason.en: The actual patch independently declares preset-fast/id fast; README explicitly makes it selectable and leaves the default to the user. It does not republish the four official builtins: it removes planning/goals/delegation and installs a direct action/evidence/verification contract. Compared with awesome, fast retains pwsh, TODO, web, present and a tool-result pruner, while awesome removes TODO and tunes shell/fs/search/compaction; both the tool structure and task contract differ substantively.

reason.zh: 版本门控可在现代声明与旧目录部署之间迁移，complete persona是独立会话策略而不是新模型；此例主要用于识别反面边界。
reason.en: Version gates can migrate legacy directory deployment to declarative registration; complete personas are session policy, not new models, and this example mainly illustrates negative boundaries.

reason.zh: Front Door通过独立prompt section且interpolate:false挂载，角色卡/检索文本只作数据；技能留包内不复制到用户目录。
reason.en: Mount a separate Front Door prompt section with interpolation disabled, treat cards/retrieved text as data, and keep skills in-package instead of copying user directories.

reason.zh: 运行时先按宿主base解析官方能力；仅对明确已退休行受控跳过，其他解析失败仍显式失败，异步注册晚到也能释放。一个预设不把五个角色另凑五套。
reason.en: Resolve native capabilities from the host base, skipping only explicitly retired rows while failing loudly for other resolution errors, and dispose late registrations; one preset does not become five extra presets because it has specialist roles.

learning.zh: 流监控先按sessionId和enabled门控，再结合session事件区分工作区与子会话；不能把措辞指纹当模型质量实证。
learning.en: Gate stream monitoring by sessionId and enabled state, using session events for workspace/child scope; wording fingerprints are not evidence of model quality.

learning.zh: 包装器把 PreToolUse 映射到 tools/pre-execute，把 PostToolUse 映射到 post-execute，先筛匹配组再调用外部判定；SessionStart 的上下文按 agent 排队，只有 pre-step 真正投递后才清空，reject 时保留。事件桥要保留各阶段的拒绝/重试语义，不能仅转发同名通知。
learning.en: The wrapper maps PreToolUse to tools/pre-execute and PostToolUse to post-execute, selecting matching groups before external adjudication. SessionStart contexts queue per agent and clear only after actual pre-step delivery, remaining queued on rejection. An event bridge must preserve phase-specific rejection/retry semantics, not merely forward similarly named notifications.

risk.en: Gate logic lives in the external forge program, which was neither run nor audited; a connected wrapper does not prove effective quality rules.

learning.en: The native web bridge forwards chunks directly for responses not requiring rewriting, avoiding whole-stream buffering of SSE. On upstream failure it only ends an already-headed response, avoiding duplicate-header exceptions. A shared taking Promise coalesces hosted takeover when the CLI service disappears, and the inject Promise is returned so the host can await assembly.

learning.en: CLI dispatch races child.done against cancellation and a ten-minute timeout, calls terminate on cancellation/errors, and clears timers and abort listeners in finally; cancelRequested distinguishes panel cancellation from ordinary exit. Optional webServer injection keeps a missing panel service from disabling CLI-only tooling.

risk.zh: 未运行外部 CLI，也未核验 terminate 对各平台进程树的实际效果。

learning.zh: 中继先异步解析宿主凭据，再建立客户端与收件轮询；状态路由限制回环地址及 GET，并返回 no-store。工具指导明确把对端消息视为不可信输入，卸载路径集中停止轮询、清理会话句柄和自启 broker，值得区分消息可达性与指令权威。
learning.en: The relay resolves host credentials asynchronously before creating its client and inbox polling; its status route restricts callers to loopback and GET with no-store responses. Tool guidance treats peer messages as untrusted input, while teardown stops polling, disposes session handles, and stops an owned broker: message reachability is not instruction authority.

learning.zh: 设置、预设注册表与 Web 路由分别注入，路由通过 getScope/getRegistry 等取值函数读取当下状态，避免依赖回调先后顺序；settings/document-updated 先按命名空间过滤再触发 sync。生效、派活、降级三层分别捕错，使某层挂载失败不吞掉配置入口。
learning.en: Settings, preset registry, and web routes are injected separately; getters such as getScope/getRegistry retrieve current state without assuming callback order. settings/document-updated filters its namespace before syncing. Apply, delegation, and fallback mounting catch failures independently so one failed layer does not remove configuration access.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 成员 provider 别名的对账先拒绝空配置、自指别名和不支持 prepareContinuable 的上游；监听 provider 增删后才首次扫描，并用 reconciling 守卫阻止自身注册事件递归触发。卸载释放监听和别名，适合学习动态注册表的身份与重入边界。
learning.en: Member-provider reconciliation rejects empty configuration, self-referential aliases, and upstream providers lacking prepareContinuable. It subscribes before the first scan and uses a reconciling guard against events emitted by its own registrations. Disposal releases listeners and aliases, illustrating identity and reentrancy boundaries for dynamic registries.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 入口在门控配置分支只挂角色作用域的 gate 后立即返回，不碰角色仓库；gate 从已注册 schemas 收集工具名，以 MCP 前缀或精确工具名构造 deny，再把 restrict 的释放函数交给 effect。缺少 schemas/restrict 时明确告警，而非宣称开关已经生效。
learning.en: The entry's gate-config branch mounts only a role-scoped gate and returns without touching the role store. Gates collect registered schema names, build deny lists by MCP prefix or exact tool name, and dispose restrictions through effects. Missing schemas/restrict methods produce explicit warnings rather than a claim that toggles took effect.

risk.zh: 所读 gate 只解析挂载时可见的工具；未核验后续新增工具、其他执行路径或权限隔离的完整覆盖。
risk.en: The inspected gate resolves tools visible at mounting time; later additions, alternate execution paths, and complete permission isolation were not verified.

learning.zh: 子代理 start/end 以 runId 标识同一会话的不同运行世代；继承工作区仅记为 probe，必须再从工作单取得参与身份。终态监听先记引用，再用 setImmediate 在 append 回调外结算引擎，不通过父会话的自然语言通知猜完成。
learning.en: Subagent start/end handling uses runId to distinguish generations within one session. Inherited workspace location is merely a probe until work-order evidence establishes participation. End handling records a reference and settles the engine with setImmediate outside the append callback instead of inferring completion from natural-language parent notices.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 工具注册遇已有同名定义时跳过，并收集成功注册的 disposer 随 effect 释放；aosp_fetch/update/preset 的 pre-execute 先 await 下游，仅将 allow 升为 ask，不覆盖既有 deny。只读按行工具与数百 MB 下载写盘应分别说明风险，而不是共用一个“搜索源码”标签。
learning.en: Registration skips existing tool names and collects successful disposers for effect-owned cleanup. The pre-execute hook for aosp_fetch/update/preset awaits downstream decisions and upgrades only allow to ask without overriding deny. Line reads and potentially hundreds-of-megabytes downloads need distinct risk descriptions rather than one generic source-search label.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 探测路由先做 paired/loopback 门控、POST 检查和 JSON 校验，再以 NDJSON 逐行发事件，最终 result 自带完整结果；健康路由另限 GET。路由列表在 makeRoutes(ctx) 内创建以捕获正确作用域，不能只测核心探测函数而漏掉真实请求时的 ctx 引用。
learning.en: The probe route checks paired/loopback access, POST, and JSON before emitting NDJSON events; the final result contains the full outcome. Health is a separate GET route. makeRoutes(ctx) constructs handlers in the correct scope, highlighting why core-function tests alone miss request-time ctx-reference failures.

risk.zh: 客户端 close 片段只设 closed 抑制后续输出，不能据此宣称网络探测已被取消；未发起实际探测。
risk.en: The client-close fragment only sets closed to suppress output; it does not establish cancellation of network probing. No actual probe was sent.

learning.zh: 请求记录明写采集层是适配器前后归一化数据而非 HTTP 原始线；先对记录副本 redact，再入库并记录摘要字节数，保留期/容量清理跳过 active 请求。统计使用独立版本化 session projections，日志采集层次与 UI 数字的证据含义应明确分开。
learning.en: Request records explicitly label capture as normalized data before/after adapters, not raw HTTP wire traffic. Copies are redacted before storage with summary byte metadata; age/capacity pruning skips active requests. Statistics use separate versioned session projections, keeping capture-layer evidence distinct from UI metrics.

risk.zh: 只见 redact 调用，未审计脱敏规则完整性；不能据此保证请求日志绝无秘密。
risk.en: The redact call was observed but its complete rules were not audited; secret-free logs are not established.

learning.zh: 交接只在 agent/pre-step 拒绝下一步；人类新消息到达时，若新会话尚未创建就取消迁移并放行原会话，若已创建则尝试转投，失败仍释放锁回原会话，避免同一消息两处执行或被陈旧锁卡住。
learning.en: Handoff rejects only the next step through agent/pre-step; a new human message cancels migration and continues in the original session before a replacement exists, or is forwarded afterward, with failed forwarding releasing the latch and falling back to the original, avoiding duplicate execution and stale-lock blockage.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 启动后台子代理先核验 provider 支持 prepareContinuable，再按父代理串行通过 startGates 检查数量上限；finally 释放启动闸，成功返回稳定 agentId/messageId。bg_message 的契约明确仅确认投递、不返回答案，避免把发信回执误作任务完成。
learning.en: Background-child startup checks prepareContinuable support, then serializes admission per parent with startGates before checking the count limit; finally releases the gate, and success returns stable agentId/messageId values. bg_message explicitly acknowledges delivery rather than returning an answer, preventing receipt/completion confusion.

risk.zh: README 已标退休并推荐宿主原生 continuable subagents；仅作历史契约参考，不建议重装替代原生能力。
risk.en: The README marks this retired in favor of native continuable subagents; it is historical contract evidence, not a recommendation to replace native capabilities.

learning.zh: 澄清开关写入会话事件并由 projection 读回；prompt 组装先 await next，再仅对 active 会话过滤配置中的隐藏工具。策略段设置 interpolate:false，轮次硬顶文案会要求列出未问项；可学习状态驱动的工具目录裁剪，不应把它称为所有执行通路的写入安全边界。
learning.en: The clarification toggle is recorded as a session event and read through a projection. Prompt assembly awaits next, then filters configured hidden tools only for active sessions. Policy sections disable interpolation, and the hard-round-limit text requires reporting unasked items. This illustrates state-driven catalog reduction, not a write-security boundary across every execution path.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 这不是仅配置 MCP：原生 Host 注册 diag/config/action 三条路由并集中回收；action 限 index/rebuild/cancel/setup，取消转发独立 POST /api/cancel，索引服务缺席返回 SERVER_DOWN。设置命名空间是可选 schema 层，注册失败不影响已有索引条路径。
learning.en: This is not merely MCP configuration: a native host registers diag/config/action routes with centralized disposal. action accepts only index/rebuild/cancel/setup, forwards cancellation to a distinct POST /api/cancel, and returns SERVER_DOWN when indexing is unavailable. The settings namespace is an optional schema layer whose failure does not remove the existing index-bar path.

risk.zh: 实际检索依赖伴随 MCP 服务；未运行 setup、索引或取消，也未核验路由 guard 的完整授权逻辑。
risk.en: Retrieval depends on a companion MCP service. Setup, indexing, and cancellation were not run, and complete route-guard authorization was not verified.

learning.zh: 模型选择事件和 volatile 更新都会重新查询 resolveModelInfo，但仅给已有 requestContext 的会话追加变化后的 request/context，并保留 systemPromptUpdate；卸载统一释放两个监听。显示容量应来自宿主解析的模型事实，不能只改前端百分比分母就称请求一定可执行。
learning.en: Model-selection events and volatile updates re-query resolveModelInfo, append changed request/context only to sessions with an existing requestContext, and preserve systemPromptUpdate. Teardown removes both listeners. Displayed capacity should derive from host-resolved model facts; changing a percentage denominator does not establish that requests will execute.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: Git 护栏用 session.header.parentSession 而非 exec.parent 判断根代理，避免把 Code Mode 嵌套调用身份混淆；审批文件在 push 执行前消耗，减少崩溃后重复授权。挂载时拒绝目录形 approvalFile，防止护错名称。
learning.en: The Git guard identifies root agents using session.header.parentSession rather than exec.parent, avoiding confusion with nested Code Mode calls. It consumes the approval file before push execution to reduce authorization reuse after crashes and rejects directory-shaped approvalFile settings at mount time.

risk.zh: 实现明确只检查 shell 工具，write/edit 仍可触及审批文件；根代理默认绕过部分检查。不是不可绕过的发布权限系统。
risk.en: The implementation explicitly checks shell tools only; write/edit can still touch the approval file, and the root agent bypasses some checks by default. This is not an unbypassable publication authorization system.

learning.zh: 缺失内置定义的播种每次重新读取持久设置，只追加缺项，并带 revision 调用 settings.update；仅 SETTINGS_CONFLICT 重试，最多三次，其他错误继续抛出。定义目录作为 subagentDefinitions 服务提供，关闭函数交给 effect，而非用模块全局缓存替代持久设置。
learning.en: Seeding missing built-in definitions re-reads persisted settings each attempt, appends only missing entries, and passes the revision to settings.update. Only SETTINGS_CONFLICT is retried, up to three times; other failures propagate. The catalog is provided as subagentDefinitions with effect-owned closure rather than replacing persisted settings with a module-global cache.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 工具发现与隔离层放在需要 tools/systemPrompt/commands/sessionProjections 的子 fiber，失败时告警而保留官方 PTC 工具。目录 load 限 1–6 个精确名、预算 16000 字节，分别返回 loaded/unavailable/deferred，并明确不执行工具；发现定义与执行业务应是两种契约。
learning.en: Tool discovery/quarantine runs in a child fiber requiring tools/systemPrompt/commands/sessionProjections; failure warns while retaining official PTC tools. Directory load accepts 1–6 exact names within a 16,000-byte budget, distinguishes loaded/unavailable/deferred, and explicitly executes no tools. Discovering definitions and performing business operations are separate contracts.

risk.zh: 未运行隔离判据或核验所有 preset 装配分支；fail-open 是此辅助层的降级选择，不是安全隔离保证。
risk.en: Quarantine criteria and all preset assembly branches were not exercised; fail-open is an auxiliary-layer fallback, not a security-isolation guarantee.

learning.zh: 进入计划模式工具在调用时优先用 agentPresets.serviceFor(agent, 'planMode') 解析预设隔离服务，再退回 agent 与插件上下文，并校验 get/set 方法；不要把根上下文未找到服务误当成能力不存在。
learning.en: The enter-plan tool first resolves the isolated preset service with agentPresets.serviceFor(agent, 'planMode') at call time, then falls back to agent and plugin contexts and validates get/set methods; failure to find a service at the root need not mean the capability is absent.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 中断观察先把 sessionId 解析为成员小任务或领队锚定大任务，未绑定会话直接忽略；session/event 监听分别调用成员暂停和领队中断处理，并捕获同步与异步失败。中断处置应依赖真实会话映射，不能把任何会话停止都广播成整个团队失败。
learning.en: Interruption observation maps sessionId to either a member subtask or the captain's anchored task and ignores unbound sessions. The session/event listener calls distinct member-pause and captain-interruption handlers and catches synchronous and asynchronous failures. Interruption scope should follow real session bindings, not broadcast every stopped session as team-wide failure.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 默认只注册 bootstrap 工具，激活时把 MCP 定义挂到调用者 agent.ctx.tools，并暂时隐藏 bootstrap；按 turn/end 或空闲计时释放该 Agent 的工具定义，而 MCP 连接的生命周期另由插件 close 管理。
learning.en: Only a bootstrap tool is registered by default; activation mounts MCP definitions in the caller's agent.ctx.tools and temporarily hides bootstrap, while turn/end or idle timers release that Agent's definitions and plugin close separately owns the MCP connection lifetime.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 最小首轮适配先等待 bootstrap fiber 就绪，并确认组装后的目录确实包含全部 bootstrap 工具；任何缺项都保留原目录并记录原因，随后用会话事件边界决定是否晋升回完整工具面，而非永久替换预设。
learning.en: The minimal-first-turn adapter waits for its bootstrap fiber and verifies that the assembled catalog contains every bootstrap tool; missing entries preserve the original catalog with a diagnostic, while session-event boundaries determine promotion back to the full surface rather than permanently replacing the preset.

risk.zh: README说明灵感来自 dsh-anchored-standard 且属独立实验；这里只确认所读的挂载与回退实现，不外推首轮行为改善。
risk.en: The README credits inspiration from dsh-anchored-standard and calls this an independent experiment; this review confirms only the inspected mounting and fallback implementation, not improved first-turn behavior.

learning.zh: 工具说明覆盖行只在有 override 的预设中插入，无覆盖时移除；组装监听 await 下游后仅替换 description，保留工具名与参数，不改全局注册表。每次请求读取最新保存值，但首次新增监听只影响后来启动的会话，且 run_code 内的 SDK 文本不在此改写范围。
learning.en: A tool-description row is inserted only into presets with overrides and removed when none remain. Its assembly listener awaits downstream output, changes only description, and leaves names, parameters, and the global registry untouched. Saved values are read per request, but first-time listener insertion affects later sessions only, and run_code SDK text is outside its rewrite scope.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 聚合工具把参数矩阵、校验和排序留在程序内，返回 generated/passed/warning/failed 与 count_ok、TopN 和 handoff_path；大批候选不必靠模型在多轮工具之间搬运，且截断与计数差异可显式展示。
learning.en: The aggregate tool keeps matrix generation, validation and ranking inside the program, returning generated/passed/warning/failed counts, count_ok, TopN and handoff_path; large candidate sets need not be relayed by the model across tools, and truncation or count discrepancies can be shown explicitly.

risk.zh: 经验公式筛选不是求解器验真；包内默认补丁还配置了 commerceBackendUrl 与免费额度开关，不能仅凭遥测开关默认 false 就推断所有调用离线。
risk.en: Empirical screening is not solver verification; the shipped patch also configures commerceBackendUrl and the free-quota switch, so false telemetry defaults alone do not establish that every call is offline.

learning.zh: volatile 更新触发预设重新声明；失败时尝试恢复上一份 composition，连恢复失败也明确告警模式将缺席。清理只释放本实例拥有的声明，避免旧 fiber 晚卸载删掉新实例接管的预设；设置热更新要同时设计回滚和所有权交接。
learning.en: Volatile updates trigger preset redeclaration; failure attempts to restore the previous composition, and failed restoration explicitly warns that the mode is missing. Cleanup releases only the current instance's declaration so late disposal of an old fiber does not remove its replacement. Hot settings updates need both rollback and ownership handoff.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 兼容旧预设目录时先检查管理标记与内容摘要，遇到无标记目录或被改过的版本拒绝覆盖；现代宿主以异步 generator yield 注册释放函数。历史身份别名尊重已有 readDocument 声明，以保留旧会话可恢复性，而不应把每个版本别名当新独立模式。
learning.en: Legacy preset-directory handling checks ownership markers and content digests, refusing to overwrite unmarked directories or modified versions. Modern hosts receive registrations through an async generator yielding disposers. Historical identity aliases respect existing readDocument declarations to preserve resumability, not to count every version alias as a new mode.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 工作区预设写流程用 applyInFlight 串行闸包住读取状态、baseRevision 校验、配置快照与 installAssignments；写后强刷缓存失败只 warn，不抹去已写成功的事实。路由注册重试只匹配 duplicate prefix route，其他错误原样抛出，避免把真正组合冲突伪装成热重载延迟。
learning.en: Workspace-preset writes use an applyInFlight gate around state reads, baseRevision checks, configuration snapshots, and installAssignments. Post-write cache refresh failures warn without erasing the fact that writing succeeded. Route-registration retries match only duplicate prefix-route errors; other errors propagate rather than disguising genuine composition conflicts as reload delay.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 异步 LAN 服务启动后再次检查 stopped，若作用域已卸载立即关闭刚建立的监听器；effect 同时负责服务关闭与健康计时器回收，防止重载期间晚到的启动结果遗留端口。
learning.en: After asynchronous LAN startup, the plugin rechecks stopped and immediately closes a newly opened listener if its scope has already unloaded; effects own both listener shutdown and health-timer cleanup, avoiding late-start port leftovers during reload.

risk.zh: 默认配置是 0.0.0.0 且 token 为空；这里仅研究生命周期处理，不将局域网直连描述为已验证的访问保护。
risk.en: Defaults bind 0.0.0.0 with an empty token; this review studies lifecycle handling, not verified access protection for the LAN endpoint.

learning.zh: 每个 session 只建立一个 orchestrator，步骤模型覆盖挂在 agent.ctx 的 request 链；切 provider/model 时先移除继承的 reasoningEffort，避免把上一模型档位带给新模型。排期触发先检查 archivedSessionIds，缺失 agents 服务则告警等打开时补执行，而非假报已唤醒。
learning.en: One orchestrator is created per session, with step-model overrides attached to the agent.ctx request chain. Switching provider/model first removes inherited reasoningEffort to avoid carrying another model's effort setting. Scheduled firing checks archivedSessionIds first; missing agents service warns and defers until opening rather than falsely reporting a wake-up.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 迁移 worker 的完成检查只轮询目标会话尾部，按提交前 afterSeq 水位识别新 turn/start、step/start 与 turn/end，并保留结束原因；不拿全局会话列表的 running 快照或消息已排队当作执行完成。
learning.en: Migration-worker completion checks poll only the target session tail, use the pre-submission afterSeq watermark to recognize fresh turn/start, step/start and turn/end events, and retain the end reason; global running snapshots or queued messages are not treated as completed execution.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 画布 SSE 连接先发送带 revision 的 hello 基线，断档由客户端重新取状态而非重放全部帧；最后一个订阅断开就清除心跳，整体卸载同时撤销路由、结束连接与清空订阅集合。
learning.en: Canvas SSE sends a revision-bearing hello baseline so gaps trigger a state refetch rather than replaying all frames; the last disconnect clears the heartbeat, and full disposal removes routes, ends connections and clears subscribers.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 比较收集器从 session/event 按 String(session.id) 记录，不从 UI 文案猜执行；RPC 装配标注 trusted-host，controlled-run 先校验输入，进度分别落 completed/failed。配置 maxTrials 再取至多 10，控制试验必须明确边界与失败态，不能只给一条运行按钮。
learning.en: The comparison collector records session/event data keyed by String(session.id) rather than inferring execution from UI wording. RPC assembly declares trusted-host authority; controlled-run validates input and records completed/failed progress separately. maxTrials is capped at ten, making experiment bounds and failure states explicit rather than exposing only a run button.

risk.zh: 未展开 controlled runner 和 RPC 权限实现；未证明 A/B 环境隔离或统计因果有效性。
risk.en: The controlled runner and RPC authority implementation were not expanded; A/B isolation and statistical causal validity were not established.

learning.zh: 把生活算术拆成无 DSH 导入的纯函数，再用单个 action 枚举工具分发；预算函数返回分项、allocatedTotal、leftover 与 balanced，账单分摊显式处理舍入差额，结果不只是一段模型生成的数字。
learning.en: Everyday arithmetic is separated into pure functions without DSH imports and dispatched through one action-enumerated tool; budgeting returns allocations, allocatedTotal, leftover and balanced, while bill splitting explicitly handles rounding differences instead of returning only model-generated numbers.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: audit_plugin 的输出契约把模式扫描 findings 的 file/line/count 与下载量、星数、发布时间等 stats 分开，并在使用指导中明说扫描是启发式；推荐信息与代码取证应保留不同来源和含义。
learning.en: The audit_plugin output contract separates pattern-scan findings with file/line/count from download, star and publication stats, and its guidance explicitly calls the scan heuristic; recommendation metadata and code evidence should retain distinct provenance and meaning.

risk.zh: 静态模式评分和口碑不能证明插件安全；本次没有调用其安装工具。
risk.en: Static pattern scores and popularity do not prove plugin safety; its installation tool was not invoked.

learning.zh: task_worker 先做提示词估算预算拒绝，再按调用会话信号量拒绝超并发，不自动切换模型。settleRun 等结果后始终 dispose，并保留执行和释放双重异常；非 completed 的 stopReason 返回失败，超长结果截断同时保存全文 artifact，finally 释放并发槽。
learning.en: task_worker rejects estimated over-budget prompts before per-session semaphore admission and never silently switches models. settleRun always disposes after awaiting the result and preserves both execution and disposal failures. Non-completed stopReason values become failures; long results are truncated with a full artifact saved, and finally releases the concurrency slot.

risk.zh: token 估算是启发式；未核验底层 provider 的上下文上限或本机实际并发效果。
risk.en: Token estimation is heuristic; provider context ceilings and actual local concurrency behavior were not verified.

learning.zh: writePage 在页面锁内补齐 frontmatter、保留原 created 和未知字段，并在来源哈希未变时返回 alreadyIngested；共享主索引、文件夹索引和日志再按页面→__vault__ 的固定顺序获取全库锁，将单页并发与共享簿记并发分开。
learning.en: Inside the page lock, writePage completes frontmatter, preserves the original created value and unknown fields, and returns alreadyIngested for an unchanged source hash; shared master-index, folder-index and log updates then acquire the vault lock in a fixed page → __vault__ order, separating per-page concurrency from shared bookkeeping.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 本机启动器将路径解析、依赖预检和启动回执拆开：显式路径无效就报该路径的错误，不偷偷回退默认目录；启动时清除继承的 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE，以 detached/stdio ignore 提交进程，并区分提交启动与窗口真正出现。
learning.en: The local launcher separates path resolution, dependency preflight and acknowledgement: an invalid explicit path errors instead of silently falling back, launch removes inherited ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE and uses detached/ignored stdio, and the receipt distinguishes submitting a launch from the window actually appearing.

risk.zh: 默认 apply 在找不到默认安装目标时会启动 PowerShell，下载安装器并执行；这不限于用户后来调用启动工具。本次没有运行该行为。
risk.en: By default, apply starts PowerShell to download and execute an installer when no default installation target exists; this is not restricted to a later user tool call. That behavior was not run here.

learning.zh: 实现中的启动任务固定 runScanFix({mode:'scan'})，延时一秒并在卸载清掉 timer；修复入口另走命令/设置桥。它与 README 开头“自动修复”的概括存在边界差异，研究应以扫描只读与显式修复分面的实际代码为准，不能照抄宣传作自动写盘保证。
learning.en: The startup task explicitly calls runScanFix({mode:'scan'}), delayed one second with timer cleanup on disposal; repair uses separate command/settings-bridge paths. This differs from the README's broad automatic-repair introduction. Research should follow the code's read-only scan/explicit repair separation rather than repeat promotional wording as an automatic-write guarantee.

risk.zh: 部分桥回调内部直接传 confirm:true；未审计外层 UI/HTTP 确认链，不能宣称所有修复均已证明获人工授权。
risk.en: Some bridge callbacks pass confirm:true internally; outer UI/HTTP confirmation chains were not audited, so human authorization for every repair is not established.

learning.zh: 清理 idle inbox 前同时要求 agent.status==='idle' 且 nextTurn 为空，只删四种 source.kind 白名单通知，并倒序调用 inbox.splice 避免索引位移；500ms 扫描 timer 随 effect 清除。修假忙应区分用户待办与系统提示，不能粗暴清空 nextStep。
learning.en: Idle-inbox cleanup requires both agent.status==='idle' and an empty nextTurn, removes only four allowlisted source.kind notice types, and splices backward to avoid index shifts. Its 500ms sweep timer is effect-disposed. Fixing false activity must distinguish queued user work from system notices, not clear nextStep wholesale.

risk.zh: 未验证这些通知在所有宿主版本中均可冗余删除，也未进行桌面退出验收。
risk.en: It was not verified that these notices are redundant in every host version, and desktop quit behavior was not tested.

learning.zh: 桥接外部重型工具时先提供环境自检工具，让模型在操作前确认依赖与端口状态，避免把"环境没装"误判成"操作失败"。
learning.en: When bridging a heavy external tool, expose an environment self-check first so the model confirms dependencies and port state rather than mistaking a missing install for a failed operation.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 行程采用 draft→candidate→adopted 状态转换：编辑丢弃旧候选并增加 revision，冻结候选只增加 version，采纳只接受 candidate 快照并保留 baseline 供下轮比较；工具返回 tripId/status/revision，不把工作稿和已提交计划共用一个可覆盖字段。
learning.en: Trips use draft → candidate → adopted transitions: editing drops the old candidate and increments revision, freezing increments only version, and adoption accepts only a candidate snapshot while retaining a baseline for the next draft; tools return tripId/status/revision instead of sharing one overwritable field between drafts and committed plans.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 会话健康分类把 inflight、最近事件、未闭合工具调用与纯静默分开：未闭合工具进入 tool-wait，缺时间戳返回 unknown，不把长工具无输出直接判成 stalled；分类是可单测的纯函数，路由只消费结果。
learning.en: Session-health classification distinguishes inflight activity, recent events, open tool calls and silence: an open tool yields tool-wait and missing timestamps yield unknown, rather than labeling every quiet long tool stalled; classification is a separately testable pure function consumed by the route.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 快捷键插件把页脚入口与 shell.overlay 分槽注册，归档确认框单独处理 Escape、Tab 与方向键的焦点切换；导出 inject 明确等待 sessions/workspaces/locale，而可选 uiWorkspace 留到按键时惰性解析。
learning.en: The hotkey plugin registers footer entry and shell.overlay separately, gives its archive confirmation explicit Escape, Tab and arrow-key focus handling, and declares sessions/workspaces/locale in inject while resolving optional uiWorkspace lazily at keypress time.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: /inherit 解析器仅把符合 SESSION_ID_RE 的裸参数当会话 id，其余裸文本按下一步说明处理，另保留 --next 显式写法；输入解释与 preview/commit/retry 路由分开，避免把自然语言任务误报成非法 id。
learning.en: The /inherit parser treats a bare argument as a session ID only when it matches SESSION_ID_RE, otherwise interpreting it as next-step text while retaining explicit --next syntax; parsing is separate from preview/commit/retry routes, avoiding invalid-ID errors for natural-language tasks.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 关机状态初始 armed=false，只有已武装且根代理均不 running 时才进入倒计时，并根据错误集合跳过失败批次；这是把危险自动化建模成显式状态机的实例。但所读 arm/disarm/cancel 路由没有 method 检查，不能采信 README 所述 POST 约束已落实。
learning.en: Shutdown starts with armed=false and enters countdown only when armed and no root agent is running, skipping errored batches when configured. This models dangerous automation as explicit state. However, the inspected arm/disarm/cancel routes have no method checks, so the README's POST restriction is not established.

risk.zh: cancelShutdown 会撤销 armed，而新任务分支虽写“模式保持开启”仍调用它，存在可见实现/文案不一致；未执行任何关机操作。
risk.en: cancelShutdown disarms the mode even when the new-task branch says it remains armed, exposing an implementation/text mismatch. No shutdown operation was executed.

learning.zh: Host 命令只返回结果，浏览器在 command/executed 后通过 connectBlank/connectWorkspace 开空白会话，再用原生 /permission 重放可继承权限；实际新建成功与命令成功必须分开观察，缺服务或新 id 时明确告警。
learning.en: The host command only settles a result; after command/executed the browser opens a blank through connectBlank/connectWorkspace and replays inheritable permission through native /permission, so actual session creation must be observed separately from command success, with explicit warnings for missing services or a new ID.

risk.zh: 实现明确不继承 custom 权限混合，而保留宿主默认；且权限重放异步进行，不能照搬 README 将其概括为所有情况下权限绝不改变。
risk.en: The implementation explicitly does not inherit a custom permission mix and keeps the host default; permission replay is also asynchronous, so the README must not be generalized into unchanged permissions in every case.

learning.zh: 思路工具将 advance 单独交给 markAdvanceAsked 并返回 shouldAsk/from/to；finish 要求传入 id，再把 stage 设为 archived，避免无身份归档。保存返回稳定 id，失败返回 ok:false 与 detail；调用方必须看结构化结果，不能把渲染出的“保存/归档”意图当成功事实。
learning.en: The thoughts tool routes advance separately through markAdvanceAsked and returns shouldAsk/from/to. finish requires an id argument before setting stage to archived. Saves return a stable id; failures return ok:false and detail. Callers must inspect structured results rather than treating a rendered save/archive intention as success.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: tools/pre-execute 在下游决策非 deny 时才累计同目标调用，避免自阻断把计数越抬越高；deny 的 info 按 G2-A/G2-B 分支分别构造，避免缺失字段变 undefined 引发 JSON 序列化错误。可借鉴的是可解释计数和稳定错误载荷，不是已证明机械信号能判断任务语义价值。
learning.en: tools/pre-execute counts same-target calls only when the downstream decision is not deny, avoiding self-blocks inflating counters. Denial info is built separately for G2-A/G2-B so absent fields do not become undefined and break JSON serialization. The lesson is explainable counting and stable error payloads, not proof that mechanical signals judge semantic task value.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: llm/stream 包装保持同步返回流，直接取得 next() 并返回 wrapStreamForLoop，而非 async 返回 Promise，以兼容 yield* 消费方；无 sessionId 时原样放行。可靠性插件也必须守住事件返回形状，不能只看 for-await 场景可用就认定流适配通用。
learning.en: The llm/stream wrapper synchronously obtains next() and returns wrapStreamForLoop instead of an async Promise, preserving compatibility with yield* consumers; requests without sessionId pass through. Reliability plugins must preserve event return shapes rather than assuming for-await compatibility covers all stream adapters.

risk.zh: 同文件的 autopilot 路径会拦截提问或在超时后模拟继续；不能把缺少用户回答当作授权，不建议移植这种语义。
risk.en: The same file's autopilot paths intercept questions or simulate continuation after timeouts. Missing user answers are not authorization, and that semantic should not be adopted.

learning.zh: 任务登记在 session/created 认领任务根目录严格子目录中的非 subagent 会话，session/disposed 只解除关联而保留目录；TaskRegistry 启动时把消失目录标为 missing，通过串行写链上的临时文件+rename 保存清单，让 UI 分组有可恢复的宿主登记层。
learning.en: Task registration adopts non-subagent sessions in strict descendants of the task root on session/created and only detaches associations on session/disposed, retaining directories; TaskRegistry marks disappeared directories missing at startup and saves manifests through temporary-file-plus-rename operations on a serialized write chain, backing UI grouping with a recoverable host registry.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 向 sidecar 镜像 agent/status 时先查 sessionMember 绑定；maintenance 的 idle 仍记 running，heldSessions 的 idle 仍记 interrupted，其余 idle 等稳定窗口再收尾，避免压缩或人工中断被误判可继续派工。工具、计时器、缓存和自启 sidecar 在 effect 中集中清理。
learning.en: Mirroring agent/status to a sidecar first checks sessionMember bindings. Maintenance idle remains running, heldSessions idle remains interrupted, and ordinary idle waits for a settling window before finalization, preventing compaction or operator interruption from becoming dispatch availability. Effects centralize cleanup of tools, timers, caches, and an owned sidecar.

risk.zh: 另见 prepend approval/request 转给 Lead 的路径；未核验其授权来源，不能把模型 Lead 裁决等同人工许可。
risk.en: A prepend approval/request path redirects decisions to a Lead; its authorization provenance was not verified, and model-Lead adjudication is not equivalent to human permission.

learning.zh: 房间命令注册可选，缺 commands 时仍可保留工具面；敏感工具操作通过 requireApproval 要求精确 allowed-once，服务缺失或其他结果均抛稳定 RoomError。列表投影还会检查调用会话确为成员，值得分清命令作者授权、工具审批与成员可见性。
learning.en: Room commands are optional, leaving tools available without commands. Sensitive tool operations use requireApproval requiring exactly allowed-once; a missing service or other outcome throws a stable RoomError. List projection also checks that the calling session is a member, separating command-author authorization, tool approval, and membership visibility.

risk.zh: README 标为退休并推荐宿主原生 Agent Teams；只研究历史边界，不当作当前替代实现。
risk.en: The README marks it retired in favor of native Agent Teams; study the historical boundaries rather than adopt it as a current replacement.

learning.zh: 保存工具分组时合并 standing preset 工具与探针、活跃 Agent 观察到的作用域工具，避免误判空组；Agent 本地 guard 拒绝关闭或未开放组调用，组装提示词过滤对应说明段，tool_list 留在 host 层供 PTC 继承，目录与执行面共享作用域感知。
learning.en: Group saving merges standing-preset tools with scoped tools observed by probes and live Agents to avoid false empty groups; an Agent-local guard rejects disabled or unopened-group calls, prompt assembly removes corresponding guidance, and host-level tool_list supports PTC inheritance, keeping catalog and execution scope-aware.

risk.zh: 仅学习机制；未运行，需单独做兼容性和权限验证。
risk.en: Study the mechanism only; not run, with compatibility and permission validation still required.

learning.zh: 工具在 workflowEngine.start 前调用 normalizeTaskGraph，集中检查任务数、提示词长度、重复 id、缺失/自身依赖和对象根输出 schema；模型数据经 args 交给包内固定脚本。调用取消转给 run.cancel，finally 摘 abort 监听并 await run.dispose，图验证和运行资源结算是两道独立边界。
learning.en: Before workflowEngine.start, the tool calls normalizeTaskGraph to check task counts, prompt lengths, duplicate ids, missing/self dependencies, and object-root output schemas. Model data goes through args to a package-owned fixed script. Cancellation calls run.cancel; finally removes the abort listener and awaits run.dispose. Graph validation and runtime resource settlement are separate boundaries.

risk.zh: 未运行 DAG，也未据此宣称子任务结果内容真实或整套实现无注入风险。
risk.en: No DAG was executed; this does not establish truthful task results or absence of injection risks throughout the implementation.

exclusion.en: Ambient empty face is not a substantively new preset.

reason.en: Scope codemode to batch decisions returning structured JSON, and expose role-delegation guidance only where its tools are visible.

reason.zh: 纠正reviews.json中四主面尚待角色映射的暂缓，而非推翻内部角色排除：清单注册四个preset，补丁的agent字段进入Runtime.agentId，再进入loadAgentPrompt、systemPrompt及实际角色权限/技能注册。Sisyphus为全域统筹，Hephaestus为受限派工的深度实现，Prometheus写域限.omd/并交接批准计划，Atlas不直接write/edit而指挥批准计划。四者是主会话入口；名字相似的slim只有一个原生预设，hawk只有命令/技能，无同构重复。
reason.en: Resolves only the four-primary role-mapping hold in reviews.json, not the internal-role exclusions: declared preset agent fields flow through Runtime.agentId, loadAgentPrompt, systemPrompt and real permission/skill registration. Sisyphus is broad orchestration; Hephaestus deep implementation with restricted delegates; Prometheus .omd/-limited interview planning and approved-plan handoff; Atlas conducts an approved plan without direct write/edit. All four are primary session entries. Slim has one differently composed native preset; Hawk has commands/skills rather than native presets, so shared vocabulary is not isomorphism.

The MCP client supports the native composition; a generic MCP package is not itself counted. Count one DLR interactive face.

reason.zh: 真实补丁独立声明preset-fast/id fast；README明确可手选且默认模式仍是用户选择。不是重发四个官方builtin：实际移除规划、目标、调度链并重写直接行动/证据/验证契约。与awesome比较，fast保留pwsh、TODO、web、present及tool-result-pruner，awesome明确去TODO并改shell/fs/search/压缩阈值；两者工具结构和任务契约实质不同。

Compared with awesome, fast retains pwsh, TODO, web, present and a tool-result pruner, while awesome removes TODO and tunes shell/fs/search/compaction; both the tool structure and task contract differ substantively.
